text: The bug is in the bottom-row and left-column loops: when `top == bottom` (single row) the bottom row gets re-read, and the left-column loop can re-read elements in degenerate shapes. The standard fix is to guard the bottom row with `top < bottom` and the left column with `left < right`.

text:
All cases fixed and tests pass:

- `spiral([[1, 2, 3]])` → `[1, 2, 3]` (previously `[1, 2, 3, 2, 1]`)
- 3×4 matrix → `[1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 12, 11, 10, 9, 5, 6, 7]` — exactly 12 elements, each once
- Single column, 2×3, and square cases all correct

The fix: the bottom-row loop was guarded with `if top < bottom` (so a single row isn't traversed twice) and the left-column loop with `if left < right` (so a single column isn't re-read).
